Coinciding with Roborock's 12th anniversary, this high-tech cleaning company is celebrating with generous discounts across its range of robot cleaners and other products, with offers running from now until September 6.

This anniversary promotion covers its products and bundles, with discounts ranging from 25% to over 50%, and savings of up to $1,600...

Saros 20

The Saros 20 pictured above is Roborock's flagship intelligent robot cleaner, featuring unprecedented levels of real-world environmental intelligence, designed for larger and more complexly laid-out homes in North America. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous Navigation System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, Carpet Intelligence System, and Smart Plan 3.0.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market, combining dual-emitter solid-state LiDAR with 3D time-of-flight technology to create exceptionally detailed 3D maps of your home. It can reliably identify and avoid over 300 different types of obstacles, from scattered cables to pets.

The AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced system that recognises thresholds and steps in the home, then uses powered struts to automatically lift the Saros 20 over them, ensuring uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. The Carpet Intelligence System automatically adjusts the body height to maintain optimal suction for deep cleaning carpets with piles up to 3cm.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-powered intelligent cleaning system that analyses your home's unique layout, floor types, and occupants' habits to automatically optimise cleaning routes.

Qrevo 2 Pro

Making its US debut, the all-new Qrevo 2 Pro is the ultimate robot cleaner for pet owners. Designed to tackle stubborn stains and pet hair, it features a Dual Zero-Tangle System with 20,000 Pa suction for 100% thorough, knot-free hair removal. This robot cleaner effortlessly handles pet dander and hair, cat litter, cereal crumbs, and muddy paw prints.

The toughest scenario is having both pets and long-pile carpets. The Qrevo Pro 2 handles this with ease thanks to its Auto Mop Detaching feature, leaving the mops at the dock to ensure carpets stay completely dry.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate handheld wet-and-dry cleaner, combining 25,000 Pa suction with 356°F VaporFlow steam cleaning.

Key features include up to 80 minutes of runtime for whole-home cleaning, a 180-degree lay-flat design to reach under furniture, blue light to reveal hidden dust, and full automatic steam self-cleaning and hot-air drying that completes itself after use.

F25 XT

If you need powerful wet-and-dry cleaning without steam, the F25 XT delivers 20,000 Pa suction with SlideTech 2.0 wheels for smoother, easier operation.

The F25 XT delivers true edge-to-edge wet-and-dry cleaning in a single pass for a flawless finish. The JawScrapers roller brush features a shark-tooth blade anti-tangle head that effectively captures hair, while a constant-pressure squeegee ensures floors are left streak-free. It shares the F25 Steam's 180-degree lay-flat design and offers up to 60 minutes of battery life in Eco mode, capable of continuously cleaning up to 4,400 square feet without recharging.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and two of its most popular bundles are also heavily discounted:

  • Qrevo S Pro: Was $699.99, now $429.99, saving $270 (38%)
  • Saros 20 + F25GT bundle: Was $1,899.99, now $1,269.98, saving $630 (33%)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25GT bundle: Was $999.98, now $549.98, saving $450 (45%)

All promotional pricing ends September 6 — don't miss out.
